description: Week-one SUPER SAYLOR update posts · four standalone posts, not a thread. Space them out (one per day works) while the boosted launch post is still running. Clip suggestions: #1 wants 5-10s of the Daily Summit panel then a fast climb; #2 wants the Ratio Bear freezing when you turn around (turn away, let him creep, snap back); #3 wants the home-screen icon on a real phone, tap, full-screen launch; #4 wants 5s of Node Runner scrolling past the candle skyline. · #5 announces the global Saylor Board (shipped 2026-07-12) · clip: the post-run board panel scrolling, or a screenshot of the top 10. Nostr variants of all five live in super-saylor-week-one-nostr.md.
tweets:
SUPER SAYLOR just got a daily mode.

Every day the arcade picks one level of the bitcoin timeline and the whole world races it. One life per attempt, retries all day, fastest climb tops the board.

New mountain at midnight UTC.

galaxymind.space/super-saylor

New enemy in SUPER SAYLOR: the Ratio Bear.

A reply guy in a verified blue coat. He only creeps up while you face away. Turn around and he freezes mid stride.

You only get ratioed behind your back.

galaxymind.space/super-saylor

You can now put SUPER SAYLOR on your home screen like a real app.

Full screen, no app store, no account. Pixel Saylor living on your phone between your bank app and your exchange app, exactly where he would want to be.

galaxymind.space/super-saylor

Node Runner got a new look.

The horizon is a chart skyline now, candle spires and all, and the sky shifts with the era. Genesis glows CRT green. 2022 burns ember red.

The terrain was always the real tape. Now the whole world is.

galaxymind.space/runner

SUPER SAYLOR now has a global board.

Finish a campaign run and your score posts to the all-time Saylor Board, next to everyone else who made the climb. No account · the game mints you a handle like Sovereign Hodler #421.

galaxymind.space/super-saylor
